payload.agent_blocked_reason: Criterion 9 (corpus-wide validator run must report zero errors) cannot reach zero. The event_type registry this WU built resolves cleanly — 0 event_type errors across every .specfuse/features/*/events.jsonl. But 279 correlation_id errors remain across 36 files: the vendored envelope's correlation_id pattern has no support for closing-sequence IDs (G<n>-RETRO/LESSONS/DOCS/PLAN/CLOSE/CLOSE-INTERMEDIATE) or hygiene-unit suffixes (T<NN>H), both of which correlation-ids.md documents as valid ID shapes. PLAN.md's original corpus measurement counted only event_type failures, so this gap was undocumented until this WU's full corpus run. Fixing it requires editing specfuse/loop/data/schemas/event.schema.json — the vendored envelope this WU is explicitly forbidden to touch (criterion 5, Do-not-touch list) — which is a cross-repo/vendored-schema design decision, not this WU's call, matching the escalation trigger verbatim.
